# Synthetic, independently authored fixtures

These files were authored directly as HL7 byte literals for issue #1. They are
not exports from a hospital, generated by readmit, or serialized by the parser
under test. Every person, identifier, appointment, and facility is invented.
The `.gitattributes` rule disables text conversion for these evidence bytes.

| Fixture | Independently specified properties |
| --- | --- |
| `adt-cr.hl7` | One raw ADT^A08, CR endings, 5 segments; PID-3 has two identifiers; PID-6 is `""`, PID-7 is empty, PID-8 is omitted; ZPD holds literal escapes and trailing empty fields. |
| `siu-lf.hl7` | One raw SIU^S12, LF endings; SCH, PID, RGS, AIS, AIL, AIP and NTE; a literal formatting escape. |
| `ack-crlf.hl7` | One raw ACK, CRLF endings; MSA and ERR, including an explicit-null MSA-3. |
| `custom-delimiters.hl7` | CR endings; MSH-1 `*`, MSH-2 `$%!@`; two PID-3 repetitions; paired local escape contains field and repetition delimiters; trailing empty fields. |
| `two-messages.mllp` | Two complete MLLP frames, with independently declared delimiter sets, one ADT and one SIU. |
| `non-utf8.hl7` | One raw CR message containing literal `e9 ff` field bytes, not UTF-8. |
| `reduced-delimiters.hl7` | One raw CR message with only `^~` in MSH-2; escape and subcomponent delimiters are absent, so a literal unmatched backslash is ordinary field data. |

Parser tests assert field numbering and states against literals, then compare
serialization to the original file bytes. Executable tests assert independently
specified output labels and behavior. `tools/smoke.py` checks the archive's
checksum and exercises the packaged executable and fixtures with no tools on
PATH. Native fuzzing requires every accepted input to round-trip unchanged and
every rejected input to yield a bounded diagnostic.

Malformed examples live as explicit literals in tests. Semantic correctness of
the fixtures is deliberately not an acceptance criterion for syntax inspection.
